table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Mfg_Cust_Code = (SELECT M.ShortName FROM Manufacturer M WHERE ManfCode=I.ManfCode),
	Dist_Code=ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(:as_distcode + REPLICATE(' ', 10 - LEN(:as_distcode)))), ''),
	Mfg_loc = (SELECT M.AliasName FROM Manufacturer M WHERE ManfCode=I.ManfCode),
	Customer_Ref  = PL.SuppInvCode,
	DO_No = PL.GRN,
	DC_No = PL.PurInvCode,
	DC_Date=Convert(varchar(10), PL.DATE, 103),
	Mfg_Product_Code=I.Remarks,
	Product_Code=I.CustomICode,
	DCQty= PD.PackQty + PD.LooseQty + PD.BonusQty,
	Rec_Date=Convert(varchar(10), PL.DATE, 103),
	Batch_No=PD.Batch, 
	Tr_No = PL.PurInvCode,
	Tr_Date=Convert(varchar(10), PL.DATE, 103)
FROM
	PurLedger PL,
	PurDetail PD,
	Supplier S,
	Accounts A,
	Item I
WHERE
	PL.PurInvCode = PD.PurInvCode AND
	PL.POSTED = 'Y' AND
	PD.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.ManfCode IN (:ai_manfcode) AND
	PL.SuppCode = S.SuppCode AND
	S.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND 
	PL.DATE BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate
